headline: Nola, Arraez lead Phillies to sweep of Marlins
recap: Aaron Nola struck out eight over seven innings, and Luis Arraez backed him with a two-run homer in the third inning -- his second of the season -- as the Phillies beat the Miami Marlins 4-1 on Wednesday night to complete a three-game sweep. Philadelphia also scored in the second and seventh innings; Javier Sanoja's solo home run in the sixth was the only run Nola allowed. Trea Turner added an RBI double, Garrett Stubbs went 2 for 3 with an RBI, and Jhoan Duran closed it out for his 28th save.
The win extended the Phillies' winning streak to six games. Philadelphia is 70-58, 4.5 games behind the first-place Atlanta Braves (74-53) in the NL East.

The Phillies are off Thursday before opening a three-game series at home against the St. Louis Cardinals on Friday. Jesus Luzardo is set to start for Philadelphia; a Cardinals starter has not yet been announced. First pitch is scheduled for 6:40 PM ET.
